# Typical Bell Activation

This repository proves quantitative Haar-typical Bell activation for every fixed
finite family of incompatible unbiased binary qubit measurements, and the exact
typical-state threshold under independent local depolarization with one qubit
per party. The measurement menu is fixed; the Bell functional is state dependent.

Scientific entrypoint: science/README.md

Keep these distinctions explicit: ordinary versus genuine multipartite
nonlocality; full behavior versus full correlations; fixed measurements versus
state-tailored inequalities; local depolarization versus global white noise;
absolute local normalization versus arbitrary affine one-sided ratios;
existential threshold already known versus typical quantitative activation;
exponential Bell ratio versus sample complexity. The constructive rate is not
claimed optimal. A fixed positive ratio is different from an arbitrarily small
first violation. Current proofs have one authoritative home by scientific topic.

For a study request, use the selected Scarani (2019, first edition) bridge and
the milestone map; map conceptual explanations to the exact science sources.
For a specialist result or proof request, use science/ directly. For a numerical
reproduction request, use verification/. The shared learning map records the
project's understanding targets and does not establish any reader's mastery.
